text:
Maria: Quick async status for parachute dry-run on slice-7. Posting what I did / blockers / next.

Alex: Ran a 5k request smoke across the canary pool. No hard errors, success rate 99.9%, CPU ~68%. Latency stable. :thumbsup:

Ravi: Noticed p50 jump ~18% in the first 60s, looks like KV cache cold misses. I queued a warmup job but haven't verified propagation to every canary pod.

Maria: @Ravi can you paste the trace link and the warmup job id so we can correlate?

Ravi: Trace: https://internal-traces/reports/trace/ef34gh   Warmup job: warmup-2026-03-17-17

Li: Feature flags: parachute-ff is internal-only for this run. Telemetry bumped to debug.

Jen: QA found embedding token accounting drift for long prompts in staging. Repro case added, PR #482 fixes counting logic. Merged into canary image.

deploy-bot: deploy created by Alex for service/inference-canary @ 2165439999 - image: gcr/redwood/infer:canary-20260317-b

Alex: Deployed patched image and started traffic ramp 0->3% over 10m.

Ravi: After the patch and second minute, p50 returned to baseline. Embedding hot-path confirmed as source.

Maria: Blocker: tenant "acme-analytics" in the slice shows elevated error variance (~0.5%). @Alex can you check if their request pattern matches the spike window?

Alex: Looking at their logs now. They hit a burst of ~30 concurrent long-sequence requests at t+4m which correlates with the errors. I'll apply a soft concurrency cap for them in the slice.

Li: Question for product: if soft-limit doesn't stabilize them, prefer auto-fallback to a smaller model or enforce throttling? My vote: auto-fallback first hour, then manual rollback if it persists.

Maria: Agreed. Policy set: parachute -> prefer-smaller-model, cap-concurrency 20 for 60m. I'll add to rollout policy doc and link here.

Jen: I added a condensed smoke checklist to the runbook:

```
- GET /health -> 200
- POST /v1/generate with short prompt -> <=3s and 200
- Quick embed token count validation
- Telemetry check: debug enabled
```

Ravi: Warmup snippet I used (one-liner to prime KV across canary pods):

```
kubectl -n inference exec -it $(kubectl -n inference get pods -l role=canary -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- /bin/sh -c "python warm_kv.py --prefix parachute-test"
```

Alex: Ran the warmup across the slice, dashboards show warmed cache metrics.

Maria: Plan: observe for 15m. If SLOs hold, ramp to 10% at +30m. Trigger parachute fallback if error variance > 0.2% or p95 exceeds target.

Li: Notified legal and stakeholders with a short heads-up; they're tracking but will only intervene on customer impact.

Jen: QA will run the targeted regression suite at +10m after warm metrics stabilize.

Ravi: I'll monitor KV and trace alerts and drop an update here on anomalies.

Alex: Dashboards: https://grafana/internal/d/rollouts/parachute

Maria: Thanks all. Post anything urgent here. I'll update with the +30m ramp decision. :wave:
